svg.text: Study design and independent evaluation
Pilot gate: freeze task, embodiment, parent and statistical design
Native environment / controller / action / observation / success; B0 provenance and hash
Audit simulator and real-robot correspondence; fix effect size, seeds, episodes, budget and options
Main study: ≥2 distinct tasks · one student backend · ≥3 ordered interventions
B0 frozen parent (zero incremental cost reference)
B3 fixed | B3+adapt-rule | B3+adapt-current | B3+adapt-history
Same actions, tools, gate and resource caps; charge rejected candidates and extra training
Source control: 2 × 2 on ≥1 main task; reuse the academy main method
Native AM-Bench / AirSpark × B1 coverage / B3+adapt-history revision
Same B0, matched deployment contract and collection budget; source effect is a bundle
Frozen student: native AM-Bench
Unmodified task, robot and scoring contract
Sealed starts T; no feedback to learning
Contract mismatches → derived setting
Change from B0 + within/cross-source contrasts
Frozen student: physical robot
3DGS appearance + explicit physics/robot registration
B0 / strongest fixed or rule / history method
Different body: matched parent and explicit loop cost
Separate corresponding scene and held-out layouts
H1: reliable supervision and cost H2: matched-budget revision gains H3: native and physical-real evidence
Proposed protocol; task correspondence, statistical scale and quantitative results remain pilot-dependent
